about: You are Jason Brody, stranded on a lawless tropical archipelago.

Confront the infamous Vaas Montenegro, make brutal choices, and fight to escape a descent into madness that will change Jason forever.CHOOSE HOW YOU FIGHT Assault outposts with rifles and explosives, snipe from the hills, or slip in with takedowns…

Craft syringes and gear, upgrade skills, and use the environment to flip the odds.DISCOVER A LETHAL PARADISE Roam mountain ridges, swamps, and white sand beaches in a tropical playground packed with dangers and secrets.
Hunt wildlife, track relics and loot, play side activities, and travel by land, sea, or air as you battle through towns, temples, and river ports.
summary: Stranded on the Rook Islands as Jason Brody, fight your way through a lawless tropical open world using a powerful arsenal to save your friends and escape the madness of this acclaimed visceral FPS.
